# PragYantra

Source archive from [PragYantra](https://github.com/sriramsme/pragYantra) commit
`57068a8aa33c92b8f489568a7902af20080200e0`. Built with `uv build --sdist`
from a clean export. Includes the original source and GPLv3 license.

The rover uses APIs that aren't published upstream yet, so it installs this
archive instead. Replace it with a pinned upstream dependency once available.
